relevance_rank_note: bioRxiv preprint: Rab5 early-endosome number in APOE2/3/4 knock-in mouse cortex, hippocampus and entorhinal cortex by age and sex; only sex- and age-split pairwise E4 vs E3 contrasts are extracted (interaction-only results skipped); class 3 surrogates with mixed direction (lower in young males, higher in old females).

description: In young (5-6 month) male mice, total Rab5 early-endosome number in the hippocampus was lower in APOE4 than APOE3 knock-ins.
quote: At young age, there was a male-specific decrease of APOE4 T-EE levels compared to APOE2 and APOE3 (Fig. 8C).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower total Rab5 early-endosome number, hippocampus, young males)
system: Mouse brain in vivo, human APOE knock-in mice (APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4; Cure Alzheimer's Fund lines made at Taconic, Huynh 2019), males, young (5-6 months); fixed hippocampus sections stained with Rab5 (early endosomes), NeuN and DAPI (plus D4H*-mCherry cholesterol probe), high-throughput confocal, Imaris spot counting: total Rab5 spots per DAPI nucleus; data z-scored per experiment, linear mixed-effects model with sex and APOE as fixed effects within age group, Wald chi2 (HC3) pairwise contrasts within sex, FDR-corrected. Mouse brain tissue.
human_check: Box plots of z-scores; the E3-E4 bracket and star were read from the bioRxiv F8.large.jpg (1280 px) zoomed in Chrome (ft/figs/41292981/F8_large_panelC_zoom.png); legend key p<0.05:*, p<0.01:**, FDR-corrected. Effect is qualitative (z-scored boxes, no printed size). n = 5 animals per sex, age and genotype; the statistical unit may be images (Methods: N = 15 images per region), which the paper does not make explicit. bioRxiv preprint, not peer reviewed. Same lab as 29311783 (Nuriel), different mouse line.  Lower early-endosome number in APOE4 is coded not against, following decisions.md 2026-11-20 (42239208 Fig 2E: H2 does not require early-endosome swelling).
